//! Type-check native bindings against the actual owner without fabricated aliases.
#[path = "@OWNER@"]
pub mod owner;
const _: extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = owner::__sw_hweight8;
const _: extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = owner::__sw_hweight16;
const _: extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = owner::__sw_hweight32;
const _: extern "C" fn(u64) -> usize = owner::__sw_hweight64;
const _: unsafe extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = kernel::bindings::__sw_hweight8;
const _: unsafe extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = kernel::bindings::__sw_hweight16;
const _: unsafe extern "C" fn(core::ffi::c_uint) -> core::ffi::c_uint = kernel::bindings::__sw_hweight32;
const _: unsafe extern "C" fn(u64) -> usize = kernel::bindings::__sw_hweight64;
